reason: My buyers have never asked for this before the home is built, and I already have more work than time. I'd say 'email me something' and never get back to it.
objection: Nobody has ever asked me for a 3D walkthrough before we break ground. Our architect already shows layouts and I don't want another vendor, another file handoff and another revision cycle on top of a full schedule.
would_change_my_mind: A client of mine asking for it, or seeing it actually cut change orders on a job I'm already running, without me having to do any work to set it up.
